content: Table TABREF36 summarizes the results of model variants. We can again see that the use of cell states clearly improves sentence modeling performance (baseline vs. (i) and (iv) vs. (i)). Also from the results of baseline and (ii), we validate that the selection of INLINEFORM0 does not significantly affect performance but introducing INLINEFORM1 is beneficial (baseline vs. (iii)) possibly due to its effect on normalizing information from multiple sources, as mentioned in § SECREF2 . Finally, from the comparison between baseline and (iv), we show that the proposed way of combining the left and the lower contexts leads to better modeling of sentence representations than that of BIBREF20 in encoding sentences.
